summary: stui and the phone can create, rename, delete, file and reorder shared sidebar folders; the phone uses Now, Resources, Fleet and Spaces

replay.detail: No daemon replay change; edits use the existing arrangement.edited registers.

compatibility.detail: Clients use the existing optional arrangements capability and arrangement.edit action. No new mandatory wire fields or reads. The phone intentionally retires old tab-name aliases, tab links and stored tab orders; a fresh preference key stores only Now, Resources, Fleet and Spaces.

manual.detail: No manual migration; folder edits create one Sidebar arrangement lazily.

recovery.detail: No daemon recovery change; missing resource rows remain until explicitly cleared. Fleet integration fixtures reserve listener ports across test processes and restarts, preventing concurrent fixture allocation from reusing a stopped node's port.
